A '''terrorist''' was captured and held in a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Space station/Legends|station]]<ref name="TOR" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Silent Type" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. While [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]], the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] refused to divulge any information.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the Cold War's two warring factions sent a companion to convince the terrorist to reveal who his employers were. Using empathy, the individual's companion was able to prompt the terrorist to reveal his employer in a moment of weakness.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The terrorist was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "The Silent Type" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's completion was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
